controls.label: Arrows
controls.note: Where the arrows that move between testimonials sit. The dots under the cards are always there too.

top.label: Above, at the right
top.note: Two round arrows above the cards at the right, where people expect them; on a phone they sit under the cards. The default.

edges.label: Over the sides
edges.note: Two round arrows at the left and right of the cards, halfway down, on a solid circle so they stay clear.

dots.label: Under the dots
dots.note: Two round arrows centred under the dots, so everything that moves the cards sits together below them.
